limitations: The 523 primary cases span per-run source/binary snapshots, not one globally frozen build.
Before/after equality is independently checked only where both values were retained; single snapshots and worker-reported equality remain labeled.
Source and prebuilt executable hashes do not establish an independently reproduced source-to-binary dependency closure.
The later warning fixture rename and native helper replays are follow-ups and add no unique tests.
Native focus/REAPER/SDK interaction evidence is retained in the separate final-native record and is not included in this total.
No physical measurement, calibrated fidelity, audio-device deadline, or general native-DAW claim is established.
